grade_reason: All eight points satisfied from the Charges Scheme 2026-27 v2.0, the document of record. Uncertainty is zero: the rates and both fixed charges are printed. The metered reference account is a scope disclosure, not an error bar, and does not lower the grade.
notes: Thames bills the same volume for wastewater as for water supplied; the published wastewater rate already assumes up to 10% is not returned (clause 6.1.3).
There is no VAT on domestic water and wastewater charges in the United Kingdom.
Fixed charges are the single-household figures from Table 1, applied per year and prorated across twelve months.
scope_disclosures: Reference account is metered. Metering is not universal in the Thames region; assessed and unmetered regimes exist and are priced differently.
Full wastewater fixed charge applied. The abated GBP 80.43 rate requires a surface water drainage rebate the reference account does not claim.
source_precedence_note: Thames website pages show GBP 65.76 for the assessed household tariff and GBP 81.76 for unmetered customers. Neither is the metered fixed charge. Table 1 of the Charges Scheme gives GBP 66.87 water and GBP 128.13 wastewater for single households, and the Scheme outranks a summary page.

reference_connection.designation: Table 1 of the Charges Scheme 2026-27 gives one standing charge for a single metered household — GBP 66.87 water and GBP 128.13 wastewater — without differentiating by meter size, so the designated residential connection is the metered household account itself.

no_reconciliation_available.detail: Thames Water publishes the Charges Scheme and no worked example of a 15 m3 household. It is under no obligation to compute our benchmark. The tariff is deterministic: a stated volumetric rate, a stated annual fixed charge, a stated customer class and a stated period, from which 15 x 2.7346 + 66.87/12 follows and nothing else does.
no_reconciliation_available.history: Held from publication on 17 August 2026 by the v1.3 checklist, which required a reconciliation. That requirement amounted to: an official tariff is insufficient until the utility computes our scenario. Reclassified in v1.5 and republished.

validation_note: Source verified and calculation verified. No public reconciliation exists to perform.

jurisdiction.note: City is a display layer. The observation belongs to jurisdiction x utility x service area x customer class x schedule x period.
